llm.summary: The skill appears locally focused and non-exfiltrating, but it can persist pasted images and uploaded documents in browser storage even when users think they have deleted them.

dimensions.detail: The app accepts arbitrary local documents and clipboard images and stores them persistently in localStorage/IndexedDB; that is purpose-aligned but sensitive enough to require clearer user control and retention disclosure.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a static HTML application plus documentation; install/distribution guidance is limited to opening or packaging the file and does not add automatic background installation or dependency execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation language is broad for note-taking and includes packaging HTML as a skill, which could over-invoke the skill, but the described behavior is still visible and related to the artifact’s productivity purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Deletion controls are incomplete for stored blobs: entry deletion can orphan associated images, file deletion/purge does not clear IndexedDB blobs, and restored files get new IDs, leaving original blobs behind without an obvious in-app purge-all control.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is a single-file local note board with image management, folder uploads, and .docx export; the HTML implementation largely matches that purpose and I found no network fetch, remote script loading, or command execution.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this only in a private, trusted browser profile and avoid pasting secrets or uploading sensitive documents unless you are comfortable clearing the site’s browser storage manually. Before broad distribution, the publisher should add a visible storage notice, a one-click purge for localStorage and IndexedDB, and ensure delete/restore flows remove or preserve blobs correctly.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad note-board trigger language is partly expected for this kind of skill, but the HTML-packaging phrase and generic productivity terms should be narrowed to reduce unintended activation.
[SQP-2] expected: Persistent storage of uploaded files is disclosed in the skill documentation and supports the app’s offline file-management purpose, but the implementation lacks complete deletion/purge handling for the underlying blobs.
[SQP-2] expected: Saving pasted images is a core feature and is documented, but the global paste handler persists clipboard-derived images without a prominent in-app retention warning or disable option.
